dedupe_keys.name: decm cluster vanuatu displacement and evacuation centre information system

description: The Displacement, Evacuation Centre and Response Information System is the information management portal of the DECM Cluster in Vanuatu, run with the National Disaster Management Office and the International Organization for Migration. The portal says it coordinates standardised data collection, evacuation centre tracking, village assessments, service mapping, post-distribution monitoring and partner response datasets, for use by NDMO, IOM, provincial authorities and cluster partners to collect, validate, analyse, export and share operational information. It shows a historical displacement overview with major disaster displacement events tracked in the DECM database and Power BI analytics, and offers assessment forms (evacuation centre assessment, community damage assessment, area council rapid assessment, an earthquake displacement tracking matrix form, a baseline village assessment and a service monitoring tool for 2026), training manuals, SOPs including a data sharing agreement, web forms linked to KoboToolbox, and dashboards with public and restricted reports. Access mixes public pages and role-based accounts; the page states all rights reserved and refers to its data guidelines and terms of use. Caveats: the portal says some links to databases and GIS maps are planned for later, and the event data sit behind Power BI views, not downloads. Coverage is Vanuatu. It supports emergency response and shelter capacity analysis; related records are the VMGD volcanic alert levels and HDX.
